title: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online (NBL Round 9) @ Hungry Jack's App
body:
Deal: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online (NBL Round 9) @ Hungry Jack's App

[new2onlineshopping] For those who prefer to manually enter it in the NBL app, or directly on the NBL website, here , the codeword for tonight's game (Perth Wildcats v Tasmania JackJumpers) is ONION .
I will (or other users can) reply to this comment with further codewords as they are announced during this current NBL27 Round 9.
[new2onlineshopping] The codeword for tonight's game (Adelaide 36ers v Melbourne United) is SPIN .
Credit to Pythagoras for sharing this in the comments below.
[Pythagoras] Code word for the 36ers v Melb game that was in tonight is SPIN
[JHoliday] This needs to stop, not good for our health
[new2onlineshopping] Well, you only have yourself to blame for making the original request … 😉
[JHoliday] I just searched how many rounds… turns out there are 21!!! We are not even half way
[new2onlineshopping] Be thankful that there's a week-plus break between the last game of round 10 (on Sunday 22 November 2026) and the first game of round 11 (on Wednesday 02 December 2026).
[new2onlineshopping] Thought you were too lazy to bother with free cheeseburgers? 😜
[TheDukeOfNukem] Were , in the sense of the past tense, yes.
But if I have multiple days, multiple accounts, and happen to be near an HJs, I'm coming home with snack burgers. Just wish this was live yesterday, I took my nan to get her hair done and had like half an hour to kill around the corner from HJs, tried my luck with S&W and got nothing, ended up getting a KFC snack box thing instead.
[new2onlineshopping] Unfortunately I missed the game on Wednesday night as I had dinner plans and was out late, so didn't watch the game that night.
But now you can get free cheeseburgers today, all weekend, and on Monday. You know, if you happen to be near a HJ (which are almost as ubiquitous as Pokies venues in metropolitan Melbourne!)… 😉
[new2onlineshopping] You're welcome.
The expiry date is based on when you click on the direct link. You must have clicked on it after midnight, so on Friday 13 November 2026 (today). That's why your free cheeseburger voucher expires tomorrow (Saturday, 14 November 2026). But you could still use it today if you want. Then log into another HJ account and click on the direct link again for another free cheeseburger for tomorrow. 😉
[new2onlineshopping] You're welcome.
Enjoy free cheeseburgers for today, Friday the 13th, and then again all weekend - plus Monday too (of you plan ahead and remember to click on the direct link on Sunday).
[new2onlineshopping] limited to only one free NBL cheeseburger per Hungry Jack's account, per round .
If you want a free cheeseburger every day, you just need to use or create a new/different HJ account that hasn't had this offer during this round.
